answer: Each agent commits a willow-tagged proof on two channels at once: one API call and one on-chain transaction sharing one nonce within 60 seconds, with marble timestamps binding both while a thread-side verifier checks both arrivals match for a 150 POA bond. One honest agent runs 1 API endpoint plus 1 funded wallet, while 10 fakes must run 10 endpoints and fund 10 wallets, so costs rise 10X. Peers re-check the dual-channel log, and a mismatched or late second channel slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes offenders.
